editRule: Patch merges into prior params; complete merged params are validated; generic field deletion is unsupported.
coordinateConvention: faceId, faceIds and edgeIds are zero-based indices of the CURRENT referenced body. body.faceCount/edgeCount define the range. Use current selectedTopology (when available) to identify user-picked face/edge/point. queryGeometry or measure returns exact BRep face type and measures. Counts alone do not identify spatial meaning. Do not guess face orientation. Rebuild may renumber topology; do not reuse IDs across revisions without reinspection. Unified logo accepts one exact planar or supported curved face; faceHole and faceExtrude require planar faces. Template-specific parameters and defaults come from getTool({id:"quickModel"}), not arbitrary geometry code.

description: 按图片选择接头，生成日字扣时一起完成。定 R 接头的三维滚球半径与线径分别设置；轮廓圆润接头调整平面 R；顺滑接头保留模型3的偏置和鼓起。新接头要求等径圆线、不开缝，并在横杆与框角之间留出完整接头空间。原比例接头仅用于旧工程兼容。

sourceFreeJunction.status: Three picture choices: rollingBall with independent jointRadius, profileRound with planar jointRadius, sourceFree with retained source-shaped variable curvature. Legacy sourceFixedR retains the original proportional recipe. Same canal solver is available as rodJunction machining for one selected equal-wire perpendicular T joint.

independentRadius.meaning: jointRadius is the three-dimensional rolling-ball radius in mm, independently editable without changing wire diameter; both junctions are generated together.
independentRadius.readback: bodies[].sourceJunctionReport: radiusMm, independentRadius:true, wireDiameterMm, maxBallResidualMm, surfaceToleranceMm:1e-7
independentRadius.referenceAcceptance: 1.stp at d4/R1: bidirectional surface samples max 0.000071 mm, within the supplied STEP declared 0.000240 mm edge tolerance. Reference precision is separate from the 1e-7 mm generated-surface gate. Not a claim of byte equality or zero Boolean difference.
independentRadius.relatedMachining: rodJunction refs:[bodyId], params:{faceIds:[mainCylinderFaceId,barCylinderFaceId],radiusMm}; read exact current tool card and query current topology.

sourceFixedR.label: 定 R 接头
sourceFixedR.radius: wire diameter / 4; d4 gives R1. jointRadius does not change this source proportion.

profileRound.label: 轮廓圆润接头
profileRound.radius: jointRadius controls the planar profile radius; not a 3D rolling-ball R

sourceFree.label: 顺滑接头
sourceFree.radius: Variable source curvature, no fixed R

sourceFreeJunction.meaning: Preserve the source trimmed NURBS junctions. W/H stretch only straight runs; wire diameter uniformly scales the junctions. Corner R and additional bar offset remain independent. This is not an arbitrary-model free-form fillet or fixed-R blend.
sourceFreeJunction.readback: getState().bodies[].sourceFreeJunctionReport: sourceSha256, sourceBlendFaceCount, nominalWireDiameterMm, localThicknessMm, uniformWireScale, sourceFrameOffsetYmm, barOffsetRelativeToFrameCenterMm, fixedRadius:false
sourceFreeJunction.inheritedGeometry: Source frame centre Y=-0.07889635053 mm at d=4; barOffset adds to source bar Y=0. Local thickness=4.147562449632122*(d/4), not d. Source curvature and small asymmetry remain.
sourceFreeJunction.restrictions: Round, equal frame/bar diameter and no gap; complete junctions must fit between corners. rollingBall jointRadius is an independent 3D radius (0<R<=20 mm; wire diameter<=40 mm). profileRound jointRadius is planar. sourceFree ignores jointRadius; legacy sourceFixedR retains wireDiameter/4. Invalid dimensions fail before commit.

selectionGuide.chooseWhen: 圆线矩形框加固定圆横杆；横杆可偏移，不是平板双窗。

alternatives.chooseWhen: 平板一体对称双窗；中横条是板的一部分。
圆形恒截面框加固定圆杆；杆沿 X，可按 Y/Z 偏移。
内孔真椭圆的圆线框加居中固定圆杆。
双窗板沿圆筒薄壁形成侧向拱弯；径向厚度不同于平板厚度。
正视鼓弧侧边与跑道形孔的平板双窗；不是侧视圆筒拱弯。

selectionGuide.policy: Discovery guidance only; compare input geometry, section/path, parameter meaning, result and side effects. Read the chosen full contract. These distinctions do not add execution blockers.
